title: Qualify RF authority and equipment grants
description: Establish documented operating bases for selected board/antenna/firmware profiles, independently of software conformance. Record FCC IDs, grants/exhibits, frequency/modulation/power/antenna/integration restrictions and grantee/TCB change assessment under 2.1043 where applicable. For 15.247 distinguish ordinary FHSS, DTS and hybrid; verify measured bandwidth/spacing, pseudorandom/equal-average transmitter hopping, synchronized receiver behavior, per-frequency occupancy and coordination paragraph(h). Fixed CH0/receiver-home operation must not be assumed FHSS-compliant. A 128-channel list or packet dwell constant is not approval. Do not initiate external communications, filings, purchases or RF transmissions without explicit authorization. Missing grant evidence remains unverified; do not substitute amateur operation or disable encryption.
acceptance_criteria: Dated authoritative sources and exact per-device evidence distinguish allowed, disallowed and unverified configurations; no blanket no-new-certification/1W+6dBi/all-legal assertion; local admission constraints correspond to the selected basis and account for all control/data/forwarding/retry traffic. Record unresolved grantee/legal questions as human decisions rather than guessing.
